big_case.notes: The underlying DeVillier v. Texas litigation is a nationally known takings case decided unanimously in 2024, but this filing is a Rule 20 mandamus petition asking only that these landowners' consolidated case stay in federal court after a jurisdictional remand under 28 U.S.C. 1447(d). Its denial, without a response request or any separate writing, settles no doctrine and affects only these parties' forum. Moderate-low stakes.
